title: Hint Acceptance vs Rejection Ratio
dataSources: Hints (`genealogy:hint`), cemetery visits (`genealogy:cemetery`), family-photo work (`genealogy:photo`), research ops (`genealogy:ops`).
app: Genealogy and family-history telemetry — Ancestry hints, cemetery visit logs, and photo-restoration queues — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=genealogy:hint record_collection=* accepted=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(accepted="yes",1,0))) as matched by record_collection
| eval an_accepted_hint_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - an_accepted_hint_pct
description: Measures the percentage of Ancestry hints that end with an accepted hint by record collection.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which record collection are helping or hurting Ancestry hints.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `an accepted hint` on `genealogy:hint` events and summarize the hit rate by `record_collection`.
visualization: Table of record collection with percentage of Ancestry hints ending with an accepted hint.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how often an accepted hint happens for each record collection so you can see where Ancestry hints go smoothly or get stuck.
